subject: LumenPay: usage-driven proofpoint for seat expansion
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: RE: LumenPay expansion - quick proofpoint we can use

Folks,

I just had a sync with Sara at LumenPay — they're a great upsell candidate for a seats expansion. Procurement will need a short, data-driven customer quote + one clear metric we can put into a renewal/expansion one-pager. Sara said she'd be open to sharing if we make it fast and simple.

Can Ben draft a one-pager and pull the Q3 usage numbers? Aditya — can you draft a 2-line email asking Sara for a quote and metric (e.g., % latency improvement or tokens saved) we can publish? Keep it lightweight — they prefer minimal back-and-forth.

I've attached the internal query I ran for Q3 usage (raw). Once we have the quote, we'll confirm legal's standard consent text and push to marketing.

Thanks,

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
(hannah.schmitt@redwood.com)
(attachment: Q3-usage-summary.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB))

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Sara Gonzalez <sara.gonzalez@lumenpay.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — 2-line customer voice for LumenPay expansion

Hi Sara,

Thanks again for the time this morning. We're putting together a very short one-pager to help LumenPay's renewal/seat expansion conversation internally. Two tiny asks — would you be willing to: 

1) Share one 1-2 sentence line we can attribute to LumenPay about the value you're seeing from Redwood (e.g., "Redwood reduced inference latency for X workflow by Y% and made our deployment predictable").
2) Provide a single metric we can call out (example: "token cost per transaction down 28% since July", or "average latency improvement 42% for settlement pipeline").

If you're okay, please paste the line(s) below and confirm it's okay to use on a one-page doc and in sales materials. We'll keep it short and won't share anything proprietary.

Thanks so much — really appreciate it.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(aditya.rao@redwood.com)

From: Sara Gonzalez <sara.gonzalez@lumenpay.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@lumenpay.com, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — 2-line customer voice for LumenPay expansion

Aditya —

Happy to help. Please use the line below: 

"Redwood's runtime dropped our end-to-end payout latency from 1.8s to 1.1s on high-volume batches, cutting reconciliation time by ~40% and enabling faster settlement windows." 

As for a single metric you can call out: average inference latency improvement = 39% (Q2 -> Q3), and our token spend per successful payout reduced by ~22% after enabling prefix caching.

You have permission to use that quote in a one-pager and internal sales materials. No legal review required on our side — procurement is looped for the expansion discussion but confirmed approvals are internal.

Feel free to send the one-pager for a quick look if you want it worded slightly differently.

Best,
Sara Gonzalez
Head of Payments Engineering, LumenPay
(sara.gonzalez@lumenpay.com)
(attachment: none)
